note: Natrona County campground on the west side of Alcova Reservoir (~30 mi SW of Casper), the first one along Lakeshore Drive, in two loops either side of the boat ramps; docks and a reservable group shelter. Several sites sit right at the shore. --Claude
summary: Natrona County Parks (Rec1 catalog): 36 sites, reservation only (90-day window), $13.39 + tax and fees (2026), 10-day limit on the site posts. Lakefront confirmed (official site photos of 06, 20, 22, 29 show the shore a few metres off over open ground; imagery shows both loops on the open shore at full pool). County page 403'd (unread). Phone empty -> 307-235-9325. Pin at the ramp between the loops - no move.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakefront' confirmed: the county's own site photos on Rec1 show OB 06, 20, 22 and 29 with the waterline a few metres behind the post over bare ground/sand (OB 08, 10, 12, 18 also show the water close below); on Esri imagery (taken at full pool) the north loop's eastern sites are ~10-15 m from the shore around 42.5368,-106.7609 and the south loop's outer sites ~20-30 m from it around 42.5322,-106.7590, over open bare ground. Rec1 gives no site map coordinates (the county's site-map PDF is on the 403 domain), so the photo site numbers can't be placed on the imagery. Alcova is held near full in summer; the photos (late season, dry grass) still show the water at the sites. All 36 are sold by the night.
